rationale: CRWV is showing signs of exhaustion after a sharp recovery from its morning lows, evidenced by a failure to hold above the 9-EMA and a series of lower highs on the 1-minute candles. With the stock trading significantly below its prior close and struggling to reclaim the $56.00 level, the momentum is shifting back toward the downside. The invalidation is placed just above the recent consolidation high to protect against a breakout attempt.
